title: Epic Games Launcher data
whyItMatters: The Epic Games Launcher keeps account sign-in data, installed-game records and cached web content in this folder. It shows which Epic account was used on this Mac.
source: Epic Games Support, Epic Games Launcher cache and data folder on macOS under Library/Application Support/Epic - https://www.epicgames.com/help/
notes: Holds the launcher data folder and game-specific data. Installed games may be in /Applications or a custom folder and are covered by the installed programs rules. Contents are not read.

cleanup.exportFirst: Copy any game saves kept only on this Mac, since not every title syncs saves to the Epic account.
cleanup.signOut: Sign out of the Epic Games Launcher, then remove this device from the account's authorized devices on the Epic Games website.
steps: Sign out of the Epic Games Launcher.
Uninstall the launcher by moving it to the Trash.
Delete the folder named in the plan, then empty the Trash.
cleanup.risk: Removes the launcher sign-in state and local records from this Mac. Games and licences stay with the Epic account.
